description.value: Moltaqa is a Michelin-recommended halal Moroccan restaurant in Yaletown, Vancouver, open since 2018 and led by female Moroccan chefs serving slow-cooked clay-pot tagines, handcrafted cocktails, and fresh-baked semolina bread. The restaurant has earned Vancouver Magazine Gold Awards and draws a diverse crowd with its halal, vegan, gluten-free, and pescatarian options alongside live Arabic music and belly dance shows. A touring cyclist seeking a culturally distinct sit-down meal in the heart of Yaletown would find this a memorable stop.
